svg.aria-label: UML class diagram of the crawler design. CrawlerRunnerService holds a map of CompanyCrawler beans and a CrawlingProgressService. DefaultCompanyCrawler realizes CompanyCrawler, implements parseVacancies as a final method over the abstract parsePreviewVacancies, uses CompanyMetadataCrawler and VacancyDetailsCrawler, and by default creates NoCallMetadataCrawler, NoCallVacancyDetailsCrawler and StaticPageScraper; it throws MetadataScrapeException and MetadataParseException. NoCallMetadataCrawler realizes CompanyMetadataCrawler and NoCallVacancyDetailsCrawler realizes VacancyDetailsCrawler. StaticPageScraper and DynamicPageScraper realize PageScraper; DynamicPageScraper holds a BrowserPool. The models package holds ScrapeSettings, MetadataParams, PageScraperResponse and VacancyDTO. A page that fails to be fetched fails with VacancyPageScrapeException, and parsePreviewVacancies throws VacancyPageParseException. A vacancy call fails with VacancyDetailsScrapeException or VacancyDetailsParseException and keeps the preview vacancy. MetadataScrapeException, MetadataParseException, VacancyPageScrapeException, VacancyPageParseException, VacancyDetailsScrapeException, VacancyDetailsParseException and UnresolvedPlaceholderException extend RuntimeException.
